rows.en:
...I hear you've gotten pretty close to that guy
lately? I've heard the rumors, you know.
rows.notes: Shirakawa to the player, both gender versions of ext_myk_005.

rows.en: I-I'm just gonna run to the bathroom!

H-hey!
Class is about to start!
"This is the first time I've ever written to you."
rows.notes: The letter (speaker plate '??? (woman)', Nanase). Japanese double corner brackets rendered as quotes.

rows.en: "I've been watching you all this time."

"If it's all right with you, please come
to the art room after school today."
...This is the real deal, no doubt about it.
rows.notes: Male player: kakutei daro kore (it's a love letter for sure).

rows.en: But it doesn't say who it's from.
It could also be somebody's prank...
Head over now, way ahead of time
rows.notes: Choice. maeiri = arriving early, before the appointed time.
Choice: 'someone's prank, suruu suruu' (let it pass).

rows.en: I-I made it to the art room, but...

Th-that letter...
So it was from you, Nanase.

Y-yes...
I was too embarrassed to tell you in person...
I'm really sorry...

No, I don't mind at all, but...
Nanase, are you sure you want someone like me?

Yes! You're the one I want!
It has to be you!
rows.notes: Deliberately reads as a confession; the twist follows.
Also Ranka (nml_rnk_005), Claire, Ranka and Shirakawa (scd_com_722).

rows.en: Now, please take your clothes off!

Whaaaaat!!!!
H-hold... hold on, all of a sudden?!
Straight to that?! We're going there??
B-but I'm not ready for this...
rows.notes: kokoro no junbi ga... (not mentally prepared).

rows.en:
If I don't do a nude drawing by the end of the week,
I could lose my credits!

That's why I have to do a nude drawing...
Please!!
Because I thought you had a beautiful body...

(Ugh, this goes way beyond getting my hopes up
for nothing~)
Eh, it's gotta be somebody's prank.
Then let's stop somewhere on the way.

rows.notes: x4: also ext_she_001 (reply to Michel's 'let's swim too') and nml_kgr_014 (reply to Kagura's 'lots of pretty girls in our class'); kept neutral to fit all.

rows.en: Hmm, I wonder who it was, after all...
Huh? What are you talking about?!
...I waited for you the whole time.
...Th-this opening line... Just as I thought...
But it doesn't say who it's from.
Actually, this looks like a girl's handwriting...
I've got no choice but to go...!

rows.notes: Alto about the player (female version only).

rows.en:
Th-that letter...
So it was from you, Nanase...

No, I don't mind at all, but...
Nanase, why me?
Eh, it's gotta be somebody's prank.

I wonder who that letter yesterday was from,
after all...

c02256: choice 'maeiri suru ikioi de mukau' (go now, as if arriving way early) rendered 'Head over now, way ahead of time'.
c02286: shared by three scenes; 'Y-yeah, I guess.' chosen to fit both a suggestion and an opinion.
c02296: 'warui koto shichatta na' rendered '(I really did her wrong...)'; female version c02318 is in slice 32.
